exposure: state independent midwifery practice (vs. restricted practice)
interaction between independent practice and midwife density
cohort: The study included 875,156 women from 6 states whose birth records were abstracted from State Inpatient Databases.
finding: Midwife density moderates the association between independent midwifery practice and both primary cesarean birth and preterm birth, with the largest magnitude of difference being increased odds of preterm birth in counties with high midwife density and restricted practice.
mod_finding: Restricted midwifery practice was associated with increased odds of primary cesarean birth, and this association was moderated by midwife density.
cross-section timing: Data abstracted from State Inpatient Databases (specific years not provided).
